types.name: ErrorBody
types.description: Every refusal from /api/me, and from GET /: RFC §7.4’s error body.

fields.name: error
fields.describe: A stable code: `invalid_request`, `unauthorized`, `not_found`, `too_large`, `invalid_snooze`, … (RFC §7.4 and the head’s own)

fields.name: message
fields.describe: For people; its wording may change

fields.name: window_seconds
fields.describe: On 403 `reauthentication_required`: how long an identification counts; identify yourself and decide within it

types.name: Card
types.description: A card as the protocol defines it (RFC §4): the producer’s fields, the head’s (`state`, `change_seq`, `delivery`, …) and, on an order, the orders extension’s. Producers may add fields of their own, which are kept.

fields.name: to_person
fields.describe: The person the card is for; absent on an order, which is addressed to a producer with `to_producer` (A.1)

fields.name: orders.claim_seq
fields.describe: On an executor’s outcome card: the claim it reports on (A.3)

fields.name: orders.result
fields.describe: On an executor’s outcome card: how the run ended (A.3)

fields.name: src
fields.describe: A head URL: /api/me/svg/{hash} or /api/me/img?…

fields.name: id
fields.describe: The card the entry is

fields.name: labels
fields.describe: Its labels (§4.1), for filtering

fields.name: text
fields.describe: Safe inline HTML: "<title> — <lead>", the title linked to the card

fields.name: producer
fields.describe: The card’s producer root

fields.name: kind
fields.describe: The card’s kind

fields.name: title
fields.describe: The card’s title, as plain text

fields.name: sensitivity
fields.describe: RFC 0.9 §4.1: the card’s `sensitivity` as its producer sent it (`normal` when it sent none)

fields.name: effective_sensitivity
fields.describe: RFC 0.9 §9: the card’s sensitivity raised by the owner’s floors, as of this response. Outside the signed-in session, count a `private` or `confirm` entry; never say its text

types.name: ParagraphParts
types.description: A daily brief in parts, so a view can keep only the entries of chosen labels and write the same sentences, one paragraph each: "N decisions: <entry>; …." (or "Nothing waiting for you."), "Yesterday you decided: …", "What mattered yesterday: …", "And N updates from …"

fields.name: decisions
fields.describe: Open decisions that are not snoozed, every one named (RFC 0.9 §8): "<title> — <lead>" for one with no default action or sent `immediate`, the title alone for one in a fold

fields.name: folds
fields.describe: RFC 0.9 §8: decisions folded under their producer’s shared default action, "6 the mail reader proposes archiving: <title>, …". A fold offers no control: each card is decided on its own card

fields.name: producer
fields.describe: The producer’s root

fields.name: name
fields.describe: How the brief names it: its display name, or the root

fields.name: action
fields.describe: The default action’s id the cards share

fields.name: action_label
fields.describe: Its label from the card (the id when the card gives none)

fields.name: ids
fields.describe: The folded cards, entries of `decisions`, in order

fields.name: snoozed
fields.describe: The labels of each snoozed decision: counted, never listed (§8)

fields.name: tasks
fields.describe: Open tasks due on the day or before, by when they are due (RFC 0.9 §8): counted in the paragraph, "Tasks: 23 due, 21 overdue and 5 routine."; the Tasks section names them

fields.name: overdue
fields.describe: Past its `at`, or past the end of its `about` day (§4.5): derived when the brief was folded

fields.name: routine
fields.describe: Under a label the owner set to fold as a count (RFC 0.9 §9): counted apart

fields.name: decided
fields.describe: Decisions made the day before: "<title> — decided <value>" ("<title> — done" for a task)

fields.name: orders
fields.describe: Orders whose outcome arrived the day before: "<order title> — done: <outcome lead>" (A.3)

fields.name: mattered
fields.describe: The day before’s signals delivered immediate or brief, and brief artifacts from producers that sent at most three cards; newest first. The paragraph names six, then "and N more"

fields.name: rest
fields.describe: Every other thread of the day before, counted by producer: "And 9 updates from mail, goalpath and hermes."

fields.name: yesterday
fields.describe: Folds before 6 only: the previous day’s threads, one list

types.name: MeCard
types.description: A card as the owner’s devices show it: the protocol card plus what the head rendered.

fields.name: replaced_by
fields.describe: On a superseded card: the newest card of its successor chain (§8). A superseded card takes no decision: show this instead of its actions. On a 409 from the decision route, `message` says the same in words.

fields.name: message
fields.describe: On a 409 from the decision route for a superseded card: “This card was replaced by …”

fields.name: rendered_html
fields.describe: The body rendered on receipt and sanitised (RFC §3.1). Show this; never render `body` yourself.

fields.name: lead
fields.describe: The card’s lead (RFC 0.6 §3.1, core’s `leadOf`): its `summary` when it has one, otherwise the body’s first paragraph as markdown. Empty when the body has none.

fields.name: lead_source
fields.describe: Where the lead came from: `summary` is plain text, never markdown; `body` is inline markdown

fields.name: rendered_lead
fields.describe: The lead as safe inline HTML, rendered by the head: a summary escaped and cut at 280 characters, a body lead rendered inline. Show this beside the title; never render `lead` yourself.

fields.name: rendered_actions
fields.describe: Rendered bodies of choice options (§4.4), by action id

fields.name: first_visual
fields.describe: The first diagram or image in the body, for a thumbnail

fields.name: order_outcome
fields.describe: On an outcome card: whether it moved its order, or came late or from an earlier claim

fields.name: day
fields.describe: The card’s day (§8), YYYY-MM-DD: its `about`, else the day of `received_at` in the head’s timezone when it was stored

fields.name: paragraph
fields.describe: On a `head:daily` card: its paragraph in parts

fields.name: spoken_paragraph
fields.describe: On a `head:daily` card with parts: the paragraph in plain text for a surface outside the signed-in session (an assistant, a voice client), private and confirm entries counted, never named (RFC 0.9 §4.1)

fields.name: effective_sensitivity
fields.describe: RFC 0.9 §9: the card’s `sensitivity` raised by the owner’s floors (per producer, per label, for every card), as of this response. The card’s own `sensitivity` stays as the producer sent it. `private`: keep its lead and body off notifications and assistants; `confirm`: also, deciding needs the person to identify themselves again (403 `reauthentication_required`)

types.name: OrderLease
types.describe: The lease as the owner sees it: head-private, never synced

fields.name: claimed_at
fields.describe: When the current claim began

fields.name: renewals
fields.describe: How many times its holder has renewed the current claim

fields.name: lapsed_at
fields.describe: When the last lease lapsed with no outcome (A.2), until the order is claimed again

fields.name: lease
fields.describe: On an order: its lease as the owner sees it

fields.name: predecessors
fields.describe: The cards this one supersedes, oldest first

fields.name: successors
fields.describe: The cards that supersede it, in order

fields.name: card
fields.describe: Null when this head holds no such card

fields.name: thread
fields.describe: Every card of its thread, newest last; for an order, the order first

fields.name: decisions
fields.describe: The decision log entries for this card, oldest first (§4.4)

fields.name: by
fields.describe: The device that recorded it, by name

fields.name: next
fields.describe: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last

fields.name: before
fields.describe: With `from`: the latest local day before `from` that has a card, YYYY-MM-DD; null when there is none

types.name: Fold
types.description: One producer’s thread today, folded to its newest card (§8).

fields.name: date
fields.describe: Today, YYYY-MM-DD in `timezone`

fields.name: timezone
fields.describe: The effective timezone (see X-Timezone)

fields.name: seq
fields.describe: The head’s change counter now; post it to /api/me/visit when the owner leaves

fields.name: first_day
fields.describe: The local day of the head’s oldest card, YYYY-MM-DD; how far back the timeline goes

fields.name: daily
fields.describe: The latest `head:daily` card

fields.name: daily_paragraph
fields.describe: The brief today opens with ("Nothing waiting for you." on a quiet day)

fields.name: text
fields.describe: With `spoken=1`: the paragraph in plain text, private and confirm entries counted, never named (RFC 0.9 §4.1); `html` is then the same text, escaped

fields.name: html
fields.describe: Safe inline HTML, the parts’ sentences as one run of prose: "N decisions: <title> — <lead>; …. Yesterday you decided: …. What mattered yesterday: …. And N updates from …." with each title linked to its card; a lead is left out when empty or the same as the title (RFC §8)

fields.name: so_far
fields.describe: True until today’s `head:daily` card exists: the same fold, made now

fields.name: tomorrow
fields.describe: What is already set for tomorrow

fields.name: date
fields.describe: YYYY-MM-DD in `timezone`

fields.name: cards
fields.describe: Open cards snoozed until tomorrow, and cards about tomorrow (`thread: day-<date>`)

fields.name: decisions
fields.describe: Open decisions, newest first, snoozed ones left out

fields.name: tasks
fields.describe: Tasks (RFC 0.9 §4.1, §4.5, §8), by when they are due, earliest first: every open task that is not snoozed and whose day is today or earlier (an open task past its `at`, or past the end of its `about` day, is overdue: derived, never a field), and the tasks closed today: decided, or superseded by the producer’s record of what came of them (`replaced_by`), shown done for the rest of the day

fields.name: overdue
fields.describe: An open task past its `at`, or past the end of its `about` day, as of this response (§4.5): presentation only, never written to the card

fields.name: routine
fields.describe: The task carries a label the owner set to fold as a count (RFC 0.9 §9): listed in a collapsed Routine group, counted apart in the paragraph

fields.name: threads
fields.describe: Today’s artifacts and signals, folded by thread; immediate first

fields.name: late_outcomes
fields.describe: Order outcomes that came late or from an earlier claim (A.3)

fields.name: order_updates
fields.describe: Open orders with progress or an outcome since the last visit (A.3), newest first: one row each

fields.name: id
fields.describe: The order

fields.name: count
fields.describe: Its progress and outcome cards since the last visit

fields.name: latest
fields.describe: The newest of them

fields.name: lapsed_orders
fields.describe: Orders whose lease lapsed with no outcome (A.2)

fields.name: new
fields.describe: Ids changed since the last visit

fields.name: seq
fields.describe: The highest change_seq the head has assigned: it moves with every card stored and every decision

fields.name: date
fields.describe: The head’s local date, YYYY-MM-DD: the brief’s `date` changes with it at midnight

fields.name: settings_seq
fields.describe: Moves with every change to the owner’s sensitivity floors (RFC 0.9 §9). A floor changes no card, so the change feed cannot carry it: when this moves, refetch the floors (GET /api/me/settings) and recompute stored cards’ effective sensitivity

fields.name: notes
fields.describe: Every progress card of the thread, newest first (A.3)

fields.name: outcome
fields.describe: The latest outcome card, in full

fields.name: to_producer
fields.describe: A producer root, or `*` for any executor (A.1)

fields.name: until
fields.describe: UTC only (`…Z`), later than now; an offset such as `+02:00` is refused with 400 `invalid_snooze`. Null unsnoozes.

fields.name: preset
fields.describe: In the effective timezone: tonight 18:00, tomorrow 05:30, next week 05:30

fields.name: seq
fields.describe: Default: the head’s counter now

fields.name: head
fields.describe: The head id: the owner’s person id, which producers address as `to_person`

fields.name: timezone
fields.describe: The effective timezone

fields.name: head
fields.describe: The stable head id (`to_person`); it never changes

fields.name: display_name
fields.describe: How the owner is shown; not used by the protocol

fields.name: timezone
fields.describe: The effective timezone: the override if set, else the device most recently seen with X-Timezone, else UTC

fields.name: device_timezone
fields.describe: The most recent zone a device sent

fields.name: sensitivity_floor
fields.describe: The owner’s floor for every card (RFC 0.9 §9), or null

fields.name: sensitivity_floors
fields.describe: Every floor per producer root and per label (§9), for a device that computes effective sensitivity itself

fields.name: fold_policies
fields.describe: The labels the owner set to fold as a count in the brief (RFC 0.9 §9 "Folding"); every other label is `list`, so a device folds as the head does

fields.name: settings_seq
fields.describe: As in GET /api/me/seq: moves with every floor or fold policy change

fields.name: timezone
fields.describe: Sets the override, which wins over the devices; null clears it

fields.name: display_name
fields.describe: One line, 1–100 characters; null clears it

fields.name: sensitivity_floor
fields.describe: The owner’s floor (RFC 0.9 §9): raises the effective sensitivity of every card it covers, already stored or not, never lowers a card’s own; null clears it

fields.name: sensitivity_floor
fields.describe: The owner’s sensitivity floor on it (RFC 0.9 §9), or null

fields.name: ceiling
fields.describe: Applies to content stored from now on (§9)

fields.name: revoked
fields.describe: Revokes every token of the root; mint a new one to bring it back

fields.name: sensitivity_floor
fields.describe: The owner’s sensitivity floor on the producer (RFC 0.9 §9): raises the effective sensitivity of its cards, already stored or not; null clears it

fields.name: cards
fields.describe: How many of the head’s cards carry it

fields.name: ceiling
fields.describe: The owner’s ceiling on it (§9), or null

fields.name: sensitivity_floor
fields.describe: The owner’s sensitivity floor on it (RFC 0.9 §9), or null

fields.name: fold_policy
fields.describe: How the brief folds its cards (RFC 0.9 §9 "Folding"): `list`, the default, or `count`: its tasks counted as routine in the paragraph and grouped apart in the Tasks section

fields.name: ceiling
fields.describe: Lowers the delivery of cards carrying the label, stored from now on; null clears it (§9)

fields.name: sensitivity_floor
fields.describe: The owner’s floor (RFC 0.9 §9): raises the effective sensitivity of every card it covers, already stored or not, never lowers a card’s own; null clears it

fields.name: fold_policy
fields.describe: How the brief folds the label’s cards (RFC 0.9 §9 "Folding"): `list` (the default) or `count`; changes no card

fields.name: platform
fields.describe: `mcp`: an assistant connected through OAuth (/api/mcp)

fields.name: timezone
fields.describe: The zone it last sent in X-Timezone

fields.name: current
fields.describe: The device making this request

fields.name: daily_notification
fields.describe: The daily “brief is ready” notification (Settings → Devices)

fields.name: time
fields.describe: HH:MM, a quarter hour, in the device’s timezone (default 07:00)

fields.name: subscribed
fields.describe: The device has a Web Push subscription the head can send to

fields.name: urgent_notification
fields.describe: A push for each card stored with delivery immediate (§9), off by default

fields.name: subscribed
fields.describe: The device has a Web Push subscription the head can send to

fields.name: time
fields.describe: HH:MM on a quarter hour

fields.name: endpoint
fields.describe: The push service URL (https)

fields.name: email
fields.describe: An email address, at most 254 characters (400 `invalid_email`)

fields.name: public_key
fields.describe: The VAPID public key, base64url: the applicationServerKey

fields.name: url

fields.name: id

fields.name: ceiling
fields.describe: Default `brief` (§9)

fields.name: id

fields.name: codes

fields.name: say

fields.name: root

fields.name: name
fields.describe: What you are, for the owner’s record

types.name: Outcome

union.describe: 2xx: the head's card replaces the device's
409: decided or replaced elsewhere; the head's state wins
403 reauthentication_required: the row waits for the passkey
Any other 4xx: the row is dropped
Not sent yet (offline, or behind a row that waits): the card stays settled on the device
